settings.hero_desc: We build custom architectural building model of your project. Send us a commission inquiry with all the details and we will custom-make a highly detailed architectural building model for you. A prestigious centrepiece for sales galleries, launches and investor presentations.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your building, facade, landscaping and base
settings.s1_body: A building model turns architecture into something clients can walk around. We reproduce the facade, floors, interiors, roads and landscaping to scale, with fine detailing and optional interior lighting, finished on a branded base. Built from your drawings, it is the ideal reception centrepiece, sales-gallery showpiece and investor-presentation tool.
settings.case_body: Built for DRU Consultant for their Developer Client, this cased building model became the focal point of the sales gallery - the whole development captured in detail, helping buyers picture the finished project far better than renders.
settings.case_quote: Client was immediately impressed with the building model. We had multiple design changes in the middle and everything was incorporated well.
settings.prov_p: A development represents years of design and serious investment. A detailed model honours that - a prestigious showpiece that tells the project's story at a glance.
